facts.fact: Africa Data Centres CEO Boyd Chislett says Cassava's AI Factory, a 3-megawatt facility with just over 2,000 Nvidia GPUs, has been at full capacity since 1 November 2026.

Africa Data Centres CEO Boyd Chislett says the Cassava AI Factory, a 3-megawatt facility with just over 2,000 GPUs, is fully utilised as of 1 November 2026, supplying computing for companies to build and run AI models locally.
